lesson.menu_desc: O e-mail de confirmação do hotel: my, your, his, her e os dias da semana -- 35 slides
lesson.subtitle: Lesson 4 -- The Hotel Booking
lesson.title_tag: Professor View -- Bruna Defrain | Lesson 4 -- The Hotel Booking

listenings.text: Welcome to the Park Hotel. My name is Sam, and I am at the front desk. Our breakfast is from seven to ten, Monday to Friday. On Saturday and Sunday, it is from eight to eleven. Our gym is open every day, from six in the morning. Your room key is your card. Have a good stay!

Hi, Bruna, it is Emma from the Park Hotel again. A small change to your booking. Your room is not three oh five. Your new room is four twelve. It is a big room, with a view of the park. And breakfast is free for you. See you on Saturday!

extra_audio.text: Bruna opens the hotel email on her phone. Her room is 305, for seven nights. She calls Sam, at the front desk. She asks: is breakfast in my room? Sam says: no, it is in our restaurant.

lesson.pre_a1_modelo: My booking is for Saturday. My room is 305.
lesson.grammar_point: possessive adjectives (my / your / his / her / our) + days of the week
